# Version 4.152.0
> **Graphite, Vulkan, and Skia m152** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0-preview)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 previews Graphite GPU backend bindings and moves the engine to Skia m152. This preview adds Graphite bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, a new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package, backend-neutral async pixel readback, and several memory-leak and performance fixes.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia bumped through m151 and m152** — Merges several rounds of upstream Chrome m151/m152 stability and bug fixes. ([#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings added** — Adds bindings for the Graphite GPU backend across Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Backend-neutral async pixel readback** — SKImage and SKSurface gain an async RequestReadPixels API that works across GPU backends. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **New Vulkan Silk.NET package** — Adds the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package, with Vulkan tests now running on Android and Linux. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))
- **Nano Server font support via FreeType** — SkiaSharp now uses FreeType to provide font support on Nano Server. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native use-after-free and leak fixes** — Fixes an SKRegion.SpanIterator use-after-free, an SKPixmap.ExtractSubset/With* use-after-free, and a CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak on raster creation failure. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558), [#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))

## Platform

- **Windows native build no longer pins a specific SDK** — The Windows native build stops pinning a default Windows SDK version, and initializes the MSVC environment once per build. — ❤️ [@mmitche](https://github.com/mmitche) ([#4588](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4588), [#4570](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4570))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

No HarfBuzzSharp binding API changes; the solution moved to .slnx format alongside the rest of the repo.

## Preview 1 (August 5, 2026)

Preview 1 opens the 4.152.0 line, adding Graphite GPU backend bindings, async pixel readback, the new Vulkan Silk.NET package, and Nano Server font support, alongside several memory-leak and performance fixes.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.151.1...v4.152.0-preview.1.1)
